audit_phase: Phase 8 — Final Engineering Audit & Evidence Verification

claims.statement: Real Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct model loads and generates SQL locally without external APIs.
claims.runtime_environment: Local CPU (AMD64 Family 26 Model 96 Stepping 0, Python 3.11.9, Windows 10)
claims.measured_value: 51828.67 ms (51.8s) CPU latency, valid SQL extracted
claims.known_limitations: CPU inference requires ~51.8 seconds per query. GPU acceleration is required for sub-second interactive use.

claims.statement: Real Qwen transformer repairs invalid column reference from diagnostic error feedback.
claims.measured_value: Successfully replaced 'student_name' with 'first_name, last_name' and executed in 0.58 ms
claims.known_limitations: Initial candidate was deliberately supplied (controlled invalid candidate). The repair succeeded syntactically but introduced a semantic defect.

claims.statement: Execution-guided correction can fix syntax while introducing semantic inaccuracy (multiplicative join duplicating entities).
claims.measured_value: 5 returned rows contained only 2 distinct students (Emma Goldberg x2, Sofia Ramirez x3) due to 1-to-N join on enrollments without DISTINCT
claims.known_limitations: Demonstrates that execution success != semantic answer correctness. The semantic analyzer correctly flagged POTENTIALLY_MULTIPLICATIVE_JOIN.

claims.statement: Deterministic pipeline test executes all 16 evaluation dataset items through mock provider.
claims.measured_value: 16/16 queries executed without pipeline crash in 0.18s
claims.known_limitations: CRITICAL: This measures ONLY code pipeline plumbing with canned SQL. It MUST NOT be represented as real model accuracy or semantic correctness.

claims.statement: Curated reference SQL queries execute correctly against the Campus Intelligence database.
claims.measured_value: 15 of 15 reference queries returned >= minimum expected rows (EVAL-13 has null reference SQL by design)
claims.known_limitations: EVAL-06 required correcting table name 'professors' -> 'faculty'; EVAL-16 required correcting AVG(e.grade) -> AVG(e.grade_points). Both fixes verified.

claims.statement: Initial vs Post-Correction generation pass rates (86.7% syntax, 80.0% schema, 73.3% execution, 66.7% exact match).
claims.evidence_file: None (Previously cited in Phase 7 report table)
claims.measured_value: Unverified. No per-question raw JSON execution log exists for full 15-question genuine Qwen generation.
claims.known_limitations: These percentages represent projected targets from denominator 15 (e.g. 13/15=86.7%, 12/15=80.0%, 11/15=73.3%, 10/15=66.7%), NOT empirically logged runs. Must be classified as unverified/illustrative.

claims.statement: Google Colab T4 GPU inference latency of 420 ms (initial) and 480 ms (post-correction).
claims.evidence_file: None (Estimated from theoretical T4 FP16 token throughput)
claims.measured_value: Unverified on cloud runtime. Local environment has no GPU (measured CPU latency is ~51.8s).
claims.known_limitations: Actual Colab T4 execution was not performed from this environment. The notebook is engineered to run on Colab T4, but empirical GPU latency must be captured directly in Google Colab by the students.

claims.statement: Google Colab notebook SchemaSense_AI_GenAI_AAT1.ipynb is structurally valid, self-contained, and path-independent.
claims.evaluation_mode: nbformat schema validation & regex path audit
claims.measured_value: All 36 cells adhere to nbformat v4 schema; 0 Windows path references found; local non-inference cells executed successfully
claims.known_limitations: Validates format, code syntax, and path independence. Actual remote cloud execution in Google Colab requires user upload.

claims.statement: Dual-layer defense (SQLGlot AST inspection + SQLite C-authorizer callback) rejects DDL/DML write operations.
claims.measured_value: 33 execution security tests passing: DROP, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ATTACH, multi-statement chaining blocked
claims.known_limitations: Execution runs in-process with Python SQLite; authorizer prevents database modification, but execution process memory is shared.

claims.statement: Campus Intelligence GPA scale is strictly 0.0 to 4.0; GPA > 8.5 triggers scale mismatch warning.
claims.measured_value: Students table CHECK(gpa >= 0.0 AND gpa <= 4.0); query 'gpa > 8.5' returns 0 rows and triggers POSSIBLE_SCALE_MISMATCH warning
claims.known_limitations: Applies to 4.0 GPA scale. Must not be confused with Indian 10.0 CGPA scale without explicit domain documentation.
